note: Typical faculties in Nigerian universities (NUC-style names). Not every university has all of them; names and groupings vary.

arts_and_humanities: Faculty of Communication and Media Studies
social_and_management_sciences: Faculty of Management Sciences (or Business Administration)
sciences_and_technology: Faculty of Science (or Natural and Applied Sciences)
Faculty of Engineering (or Engineering and Technology)
Faculty of Computing (or Computing and Information Technology)
health_and_medical_sciences: Faculty of Allied Health Sciences (or Health Sciences)
